integrity: Proof and standalone reproducibility script included; finite experiments do not replace the analytic theorem.
scientific_limitations: The all-dimensional exact profile and asymptotic concern the centered-height Cayley construction from a regular simplex and its polar, not arbitrary realizations of cubical combinatorics; historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Santaló volume of the regular-simplex Cayley bipolar cubes: an exact profile and an asymptotic factor of \(e\)
